kind: owner-approved scope translated into proposed release acceptance checks
readiness_reason: V3 scope is new and the repository/deployed product was not evaluated in this documentation update.
product_complete_rule: Every G01-G16 must be passed with current evidence. Owner-approved scope changes require an explicit new revision. Do not inherit old benchmark or handoff percentages.
public_commercial_launch_rule: Requires product_complete AND the separately approved live-billing and public-plugin-release gates. Both are currently held.

gates.title: Single-engine policy
gates.requirement: Only Apple vX is customer-facing; approved Flash and backend Jev routing; no training, old tiers or mode selectors.
gates.evidence_required: Inspect routes/config/migration and a real model request; verify no training-only job is active.

gates.title: Onboarding and account boundaries
gates.requirement: Owner/approved accounts can register/sign in, install the authorized test package, pair their own place and access only their own projects.
gates.evidence_required: Two approved accounts through the ordinary UI; cross-project request is denied.

gates.title: Hard Studio gate and explicit resume
gates.requirement: No composer entry/submit before correct-place connection; disconnection pauses and reconnect requires Continue.
gates.evidence_required: Keyboard/UI/server checks before pairing; disconnect/reconnect an active run without duplicated mutations.

gates.title: One project, persistent game
gates.requirement: Creation, save, logout/reopen and subsequent instructions preserve the same game, chat and context.
gates.evidence_required: Reopen a real project and make a follow-up change without replacing its identity or prior completed content.

gates.title: Complete scoped library
gates.requirement: All committed owner/collected sources are accounted for and extracted/indexed; useful systems and artifact delivery work efficiently; failures are not mislabelled ready.
gates.evidence_required: Versioned source/category/system manifest, extraction integrity checks and representative rich-unit product use; no per-node screenshot prerequisite.

gates.title: Cloud-to-customer Studio delivery
gates.requirement: The production library can serve an approved customer without the owner Mac/local gateway.
gates.evidence_required: A non-owner approved account obtains and inserts a prepared artifact using the deployed backend and its own connected Studio.

gates.title: Complete game creation
gates.requirement: The ordinary product creates the planned gameplay/world/UI/assets/effects/content across the three target families with original variation.
gates.evidence_required: Three documented product-built cases, one per quality family, with a short original prompt/variation and a completed feature matrix; no manual final-game repair counted as Apple success.

gates.title: Theme and English contract
gates.requirement: World direction is modern colourful studded; UI theme obeys cartoony/studded/none; all customer-facing output is English.
gates.evidence_required: Inspect actual generated games, agent messages and UI for each theme; none still produces appropriate functional UI.

gates.title: Player functionality and devices
gates.requirement: Core loop, progression, save/rejoin and genre-required multiplayer work on desktop/phone/tablet.
gates.evidence_required: Actual play checks on the generated cases, portrait/landscape UI and input, and multiplayer when the specification needs it.

gates.title: Steering, Stop and safe failure
gates.requirement: Mid-run direction is applied safely; Stop remains usable with a dead socket; repeated unchanged failure is bounded and partial work recorded.
gates.evidence_required: Change direction, stop a real run, inject a concrete failure, check side-effect receipts and absence of duplicates.

gates.title: Checkpoint and recovery
gates.requirement: Saved restore points can be restored correctly without data loss disguised as success or unauthorized overwrites.
gates.evidence_required: Restore a real checkpoint and check actual project content, permission and subsequent continuation.

gates.title: Evidence-aware output and all components
gates.requirement: All 23 specified component families render their applicable real data and evidence; technical details are accessible without exposing secrets or hidden thought.
gates.evidence_required: Renderer fixture coverage for each component, then live event/file/source/checkpoint/usage/attachment persistence proof; no synthetic logs in production.

gates.title: Independent delivered game
gates.requirement: The game remains playable/editable without Apple, GLM, Jev or an active Apple subscription.
gates.evidence_required: Run the delivered Roblox game with Apple disconnected; verify game scripts do not depend on model/Apple service calls.

gates.title: Responsible missing assets and monetization
gates.requirement: Essential gaps are reported; high-quality alternatives are used where possible; unconfigured in-game purchases are clearly inactive.
gates.evidence_required: A missing-essential-asset scenario plus inspection of game-owner purchase configuration and unchanged base gameplay.

gates.title: Generate Branding
gates.requirement: The in-project action opens a separate English details window with actual images, names and descriptions, editable and persistently saved.
gates.evidence_required: Generate actual branding after a game, edit/save/reopen it, and verify neither game rebuilding nor public publishing occurred.

gates.title: Release-scope and economy integrity
gates.requirement: The current version has no obsolete training/loop/mode prerequisites or newly invented goals; costs and blockers are factual; launch remains held.
gates.evidence_required: Final manifest and gate audit with evidence links, actual run costs where available, safe operational logs and explicit deferred launch tasks.

deferred_launch_gates.title: Live Stripe payments and subscriptions
deferred_launch_gates.activation: Explicit subsequent owner instruction/approved launch step; do not mark completed or charge now.

deferred_launch_gates.title: Public plugin distribution
deferred_launch_gates.activation: Explicit subsequent owner instruction/approved launch step; local/approved installation must still work.

quality_family_note: Names identify owner-selected target families. This is not a factual inventory of their current mechanics or a declaration of clone/parity performance.
method_note: Focused tests and actual product execution remain; do not reinstate an endless model critique loop or remove real functional/security checks.
